description: Regulated-claims compliance wordlist for marketing copy. Each entry is a case-insensitive regex checked against the deliverable. Severity 'fail' blocks the verify gate; 'warn' surfaces without blocking. The defaults target promissory and manipulative phrasing that financial-promotion and advertising rules treat as red flags; tune per client and jurisdiction.

patterns.label: Guaranteed returns claim
patterns.why: Promissory financial claim — regulators treat this as a financial-promotion red flag.

patterns.label: Risk-free claim
patterns.why: No product is risk-free; the phrasing reads as a misleading absolute.

patterns.label: Financial advice framing
patterns.why: Advice framing invites regulatory scrutiny; counsel should review any advice language.

patterns.label: Multiplier price talk
patterns.why: Price-multiple promises can read as investment claims; confirm the context is not a returns promise.
